[[Line Lieutenant]] '''Dramos Sanjin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] of the [[Empire of the Hand]].

==Biography==
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Sanjin traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]] aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'' and he participated in an Imperial [[Attack on the Red City|attack]] on the world, against the combined forces of the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] and the [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. During the battle, Sanjin led three stormtrooper [[Squad/Legends|squads]] into the [[Red City]] aboard [[A-rack]] carriers, and the stormtroopers engaged a large number of Quesoth [[Quesoth Soldier|Soldiers]] in the street [[Setting Sun Avenue]]. The stormtroopers were eventually overcame by the numerically superior Quesoth and Sanjin prepared to make a final stand. However, the Quesoth Soldiers were tricked into leaving the battle after the Imperial forces played a [[Quesoth Soldier Speak]] recording that ordered the soldiers to retreat and defend [[Queen of the Red|their Queen]].
